title: Nine Lines of Building
subtitle: 人物与性格 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人物与性格（文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：人物与性格（文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：character　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 character 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 my mother was sent to build ① character she could not like, and she said the building was the whole of the lesson. The ② character, meaning the person and not the trait, was nine lines deep and was built by whoever came last; character, she said, is the only thing in a novel that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ character in that novel had the same flaw, and the ④ character at the end, meaning the one the author kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever built properly. Character, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ character was the whole of the boy, meaning the quality it carried and not the person. The ⑥ character, meaning the quality and not any of that, is the only thing in a boy that everybody praises and nobody questions; character, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a person and a quality. She said the quality is the part they remember.

By 1974 the ⑦ character had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the flaw. The ⑧ character of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine lines and eleven years of building; character, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ character I remember is the one at the end, which was built in 1979 and is still described as the truest in the county. A ⑩ character, my grandmother said in 1984, is the only thing that improves by being built; every character, she said, is a quality that has agreed to look like a person. She said the quality was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 人物（指那个人物本身，与那个特质相对）
C. 固定搭配：build a character 塑造一个人物
D. n. 人物（指那部小说里每一个）
E. n. 人物（指末尾那一个）
F. n. 品格（抽象：它承载的那份品质）
G. n. 那份品质（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The character, meaning the person and not the trait
character was the whole of the boy
the character had become a number in a report
The character of the whole thing
A character, my grandmother said in 1984

answers.why: build a character 意为“塑造一个人物”，1959 年母亲被派去塑造她喜欢不起来的那个人物。
character 意为“人物、角色”，指那个人物本身而不是那个特质，深九行，由最后来的人塑造。
character 指那部小说里每一个人物，每一个都是同样的缺点。
character 指末尾那一个（作者保留的那一个），是唯一有人认真塑造过的。
character 意为“品格”，抽象指它承载的那份品质，父亲说 character 就是那个男孩的全部。
character 为抽象用法，指那份品质本身，是一个男孩身上人人都称赞、却没人质疑的东西。
character 意为“人物、角色”，到 1974 年这个 character 成了报告里的一个数字。
character 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九行与十一年的塑造。
character 意为“人物”，我记得的是末尾那一个，1979 年塑造，至今仍被说成全县最真实的。
character 为抽象总称，祖母说一个人物是唯一会因为被认真塑造而变好的东西。
